promotion_rule: Every reviewed unique indicator has a reported current value and is linked to two explicitly separated target versions: the original R7 target and the extended-plan R8 target.
repost_boundary: The 135 unique indicators remain the record unit. All 141 display occurrences are retained as Evidence locations, while the six repeated indicators are not promoted to duplicate records.
raw_text_boundary: Current values, R7 targets, and R8 targets remain intact because cells may contain corrections, several sub-series, cumulative periods, conditions, or reference-year targets.
non_goals: Do not calculate achievement from current, R7, and R8 strings.
Do not treat a target revision as a performance judgment.
Do not split corrected, cumulative, compound, or reference-target text without a reviewed structure.
Do not count repost display occurrences as additional unique indicators.
